name: Enchanted Mango
commentary:
Dropped by Mango Tree, if the outcome of battle is different from the last battle e.g. will drop if you lost and then won, will not drop if you lose/win twice or more.

Randomly grants Gold and Courier XP up to the current courier level. 

| Courier level | Possible gold gained | Possible courier XP gained |
|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 1 | 1 |
| 2 | 1–2 | 1–2 |
| 3 | 1–3 | 1–3 |
| 4 | 1–4 | 1–4 |
| 5 | 1–5 | 1–5 |
| 6 | 1–6 | 1–6 |
| 7 | 1–7 | 1–7 |
| 8 | 1–8 | 1–8 |
| 9 | 1–9 | 1–9 |
| 10 | 1–10 | 1–10 |
| 11 | 1–11 | 1–11 |
| 12 | 1–12 | 1–12 |
| 13 | 1–13 | 1–13 |
| 14 | 1–14 | 1–14 |
| 15 | 1–15 | 1–15 |
| 16 | 1–16 | 1–16 |
